item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00540","case1_error":"Correctly writes 80 − 16 but evaluates it as 40 instead of 64.","case2_error":"Reports the original 190 candies instead of the 90 remaining after Carlos eats the yellow candies.","reason":"The first miscalculates a correct expression; the second answers the wrong requested quantity.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00541","case1_error":"Omits Saturday’s ten additional rounds, undercounting the weekend time by 300 minutes.","case2_error":"Adds one boxcar’s capacity per color without multiplying by the numbers of boxcars.","reason":"The first drops an explicitly stated activity block; the second confuses per-item capacities with group totals by omitting multiplicities.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00542","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 40, but the derivation correctly concludes 50 mph.","case2_error":"Includes the stationary half-hour break as driving time when calculating distance.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J00543","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written subtraction 180 − 45 − 45 − 20 as 90 instead of 70.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate correctly written expressions.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J00544","case1_error":"Leading answer marker says 20, but the derivation correctly calculates and rounds the time to 15 minutes.","case2_error":"States 500 hours without supporting calculation after a correct formula and explicit four-week assumption implying 200 hours.","reason":"The first has only an answer-marker conflict; the second supplies an unsupported final number after a correct formula.","judgment":"uncertain"}]}
